about.title: Atherton Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Atherton is a quiet town, but its busiest corridors — Middlefield Road, Route 82, Alameda De Las Pulgas, and El Camino Real — still see their share of collisions, with reports clustering on Wednesday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. San Mateo County's most recent full-year data logged three injury collisions and three injured people here, a reminder that even a small town isn't immune to serious wrecks. When a crash upends your routine, sorting out fault, medical bills, and insurance calls can feel overwhelming on top of recovering physically. LawProactive isn't a law firm — we're a free service that connects injured Atherton residents and visitors with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the details, explain your options, and help you avoid common pitfalls with insurers. There's no obligation to move forward, and connecting with an attorney costs you nothing upfront.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Sooner Rather Than Later

items.title: California's Clock Is Ticking
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but if a government entity (like a road authority) may be involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Getting an attorney's eyes on your case early helps make sure no deadline slips by.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work in Your Favor
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover damages even if you were partly at fault for the accident — your share just gets deducted from any award. An attorney can help make sure the insurance company doesn't unfairly inflate your percentage of blame.

items.title: Skip the Recorded Statement Trap
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement soon after a crash, hoping to use your words against you later. An independent attorney can handle those conversations on your behalf so nothing you say gets twisted to minimize your claim.

items.question: Do I really need a lawyer for a minor crash in Atherton?
items.answer: Even a collision that seems minor at first can lead to injuries that surface days later, like whiplash or a concussion. Since California's injury counts on roads like El Camino Real and Middlefield Road show real people getting hurt even in a small town, it's worth having an independent attorney review your situation before you settle for less than you may need.

items.question: What if the other driver's insurer calls me right away?
items.answer: You're not required to give a recorded statement, and it's generally safer not to until you've spoken with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use early, informal statements to shift blame or downplay injuries. Connecting with an attorney through LawProactive first can help protect what you say.

items.question: How much does it cost to get matched with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing — LawProactive is a free service, and attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront fee and no obligation to hire anyone after you're connected.
